mutations.contract: A region that changes size under a fitted view is fitted again, to the region's own width and height (the first paint, a resize and Fit all go through one fit).
mutations.note: Fits to the region's height both ways, so a wider region fits no differently from a narrow one and the DAG view's zoom equals Side by side's. The first cut mutated the resize observer alone and the page's repaint on the view switch re-fitted anyway (NOT WITNESSED, 2026-11-16); both paths now share fitTo.
mutations.find: return Object.assign(VA.mapFitView(geo.bounds, now.width, now.height), { auto: true, size: now });
mutations.replace: return Object.assign(VA.mapFitView(geo.bounds, now.height, now.height), { auto: true, size: now }); /* mutated: fits to the height both ways */
